FilteredSummary.title: FilteredSummary
FilteredSummary.description:
Why an empty result is empty.

Not in the original contract. Without it the plugin cannot tell "nothing is
scheduled" from "everything is sold out" from "not enough seats for your
party", and shows the same dead end for all three.

DELIBERATELY COARSE. No per-departure reasons and no schedule ids: a
customer does not need to know that a specific departure exists but is full,
and publishing that invites probing. max_seats_available is zero when the
day is genuinely sold out, which is what separates that from a party too
large for what is left.
